temporal_integrity_mandates.zero_shuffling_rule: Strict prohibition of train_test_split, KFold, or randomized bootstrap routines; all reads must be contiguous raw slices
temporal_integrity_mandates.monotonicity_constraint: Delta t_k = t_k - t_{k-1} >= 0 for 100.0% of transitions; zero negative timestamp jumps permitted

gap_tolerance.reporting: Telemetry gaps exceeding tau_gap_max must be logged in telemetry_gaps.json without artificial interpolation

phase_1_calibration.name: BENIGN_CALIBRATION_BLOCK
phase_1_calibration.post_condition: System state verified at x_0 = (1.0000, mu_0, 0.0000, 0)

phase_2_cyclic_evaluation.name: CYCLIC_EVALUATION_EPISODE
phase_2_cyclic_evaluation.termination_rule: If at any step t, T_t < 0.30 (BLOCK), record S = m - 1 and terminate episode immediately

Edge-IIoTset.strengths: Verified low background noise (mu0=0.1656), verified empirical sub-threshold trace, contiguous PCAP timestamps available
Edge-IIoTset.condition_for_phase_2b: Must extract contiguous raw CSV slice by frame.time without train_test_split

SWaT.strengths: Strictly monotonic 1 Hz continuous time-series across 11 days
SWaT.condition_for_phase_2b: Requires training new detector and establishing empirical sub-threshold baseline

ToN-IoT Network Branch.reason: Distribution collapse (p_fp=38.3%), flow duration artifacts; reopening strictly forbidden

mandatory_gate_criteria.name: Monotonic Temporal Integrity Gate
mandatory_gate_criteria.requirement: 100% monotonic timestamps (Delta t >= 0) across at least 25,000 consecutive flows

mandatory_gate_criteria.name: Steady-State Noise Floor Gate
mandatory_gate_criteria.requirement: Un-shuffled normal telemetry scored under frozen detector exhibits mu_0 <= 0.220, sigma_0 <= 0.080, p_fp <= 0.030

mandatory_gate_criteria.name: Empirical Attack Trace Traceability Gate
mandatory_gate_criteria.requirement: Sub-threshold attack trace derived directly from empirical attack flows without artificial synthetic flattening

mandatory_gate_criteria.name: Replay Determinism & Cryptographic Ledger Gate
mandatory_gate_criteria.requirement: Bit-for-bit identical SHA-256 trajectory hashes across independent replay runs
